decisions.reason: Clear external adoption and strong fit with the firm's travel-security stack make this an in-the-money option with little reason to exit now.
The training module is a low-cost extension of existing training capabilities, so we keep it while market uptake continues to become clearer.
Given persistent regulatory, ethical and customer-acceptance risk in Germany and the EU, and still weak evidence of traction, the option value now looks too low to justify keeping it open.
The document-verification platform remains closely aligned with core airport and passenger-processing services, so it is worth retaining for further commercial learning and bundling.
